changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 1: the shared max-lines lint gate now counts code lines only (blank lines and comments excluded), so trimming comments or whitespace can no longer be used to duck the 700-line cap. Lint config and test-case deletion only; no runtime or published-API change.

Code organization refactor stage 1: added a warn-only dependency-cruiser gate (no-circular plus a layer-order rule over today's src/ directories) to npm run lint, as a monitoring baseline for the multi-stage refactor. Dev-tooling only; no runtime or published-API change.

Code organization refactor stage 1: the shared package-wide re-export ban now covers this package outside src/service/index.ts (previously service/** only), and a warn-only filename-convention lint rule flags *-helpers.ts/*-support.ts/*-ops.ts-style files repo-wide. Lint config and inline eslint-disable comments only; no runtime or published-API change.

Code organization refactor stage 1: added a warn-only Knip unused-export report (project scope driven by tsconfig.tests.json's src/+tests/ file list, with src/server.ts and src/service/index.ts allowlisted as entry points) to npm run lint, as a monitoring baseline for the multi-stage refactor. Dev-tooling only; no runtime or published-API change.

Code organization refactor stage 1: deleted the package-boundary-guards.test.ts case pinning dreamux-types index.ts's exact export-name set, since it regex-matches brace-block exports and dreamux-types's root barrel no longer has any (it now re-exports via export type * per module). Test-only; no runtime or published-API change.
